# Superhero Santa

> Superhero Santa is a series of Christ-centered Christmas picture books. Santa is brave, kind and a little bit super, but he is the helper, not the point: every book ends where Christmas begins, with a family, a bright star and the birth of Jesus. Book One, "Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing!", is a toddler bedtime reader for ages 1 to 3 and is coming soon in print and ebook.

## Book One: Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing!

- Author: Steven L. Woodfield.
- Format: toddler bedtime reader, ages 1 to 3. Short lines, big pictures, a ten-minute read made to read aloud.
- Story: after the presents have been delivered and the New Year has rung in, the nine sleigh Reindeer vanish. Santa doesn't panic: he pulls on his boots, gathers his best elves and a very old map, and sets off along a long, snowy trail past the pines, under a sky full of stars. There are no hoofprints and no clues.
- Characters: Santa (the helper), Mrs. Claus (the heart of the house), the elf (the map-reader), the elf boy (elf-in-training), the elf girl (the one who points) and the Reindeer (the one with the nose).
- Ending: the story ends where Christmas begins, with a family and a bright star witnessing the birth of Jesus.
- Status: coming soon in print and ebook, in fall 2027.

## The series

- Superhero Santa is currently a five-book series. It begins with the toddler bedtime reader; a full-edition picture book and a children's book are soon to follow.
- More picture books are in the works: new adventures with Santa and the elves, each pointing back to the first Christmas.
- A novel series for teens is in development, set in the same world for readers who grew up on the picture books.

## Questions parents ask

- What ages is it for? Ages 1 to 3. Book One is a toddler bedtime reader: short lines, big pictures, about a ten-minute read, made to read aloud.
- Is it a Christian book? Yes. Santa is the helper, not the point: every Superhero Santa book ends where Christmas begins, with a family, a bright star and the birth of Jesus.
- Is it in print or ebook? Both: Book One is coming soon in print and ebook, in fall 2027.
- Are more books coming? Yes. Superhero Santa is currently a five-book series.

## About the author

Steven was raised in a faithful Christian family with a love of Christmas. As for most, the magic of Christmas wanes as we age. These stories of Santa rekindle the belief in the magic of Christmas.

## Who it is for

Parents and families who want the magic and the meaning of Christmas in the same bedtime story.
